description: Use this when the person asks whether their bought-in parts are covered by supplier declarations, on a date or for exports to a partner country such as Switzerland or the UK. Returns the cover report of the connected account on a date (default today): how many bought-in articles have a valid, checked supplier declaration, and which do not, with the reason (missing, expired, revoked, not checked, single shipment only, refused, no preferential origin) and the suppliers concerned. Optionally for one agreement (id such as ch, uk, mercosur) or one partner country (ISO code such as CH or BR). It says which articles a declaration covers, never whether goods have preferential origin. Do not use to calculate preferential origin or to decide whether a proof of origin may be issued; ProofPass only shows which declarations exist.

agreement.description: Agreement id, e.g. ch, uk, ca, jp, mercosur

country.description: Partner country, ISO 3166 alpha-2, e.g. CH

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

name: get_declaration_coverage
title: Cover report of supplier declarations
